disorder-name.detail: Autism spectrum disorder clinical cohort. Includes two subgroups: ASD with DD/ID (n=563) and ASD without DD/ID (n=212), both diagnosed per DSM-5 with ADOS or ADOS-toddler. Combined as one Minor category (ASD) for extraction. DD/ID comorbidity determined by GDS < 75 or full IQ < 70.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "563 children diagnosed with ASD and DD/ID... 212 children diagnosed with ASD without DD/ID"

dataset-of-origin.detail: All participants recruited from the Shanghai Autism Early Developmental (SAED) Cohort, from Xinhua Hospital, Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "Participants were recruited from a neurodevelopmental project - Shanghai Autism Early Development Cohort"

age.detail: Combined ASD group (n=775): ASD with DD/ID (n=563, 3.98±1.22 years, range 1.26–6.93) and ASD without DD/ID (n=212, 3.24±1.15 years, range 1.13–6.95). Weighted mean = (563×3.98 + 212×3.24)/775 = 3.78 years. Pooled SD = sqrt(((562×1.22²)+(211×1.15²))/773) = 1.20 years. Overall range taken as min(1.26, 1.13)=1.13, max(6.93, 6.95)=6.95.
age.supporting_text: "563 children diagnosed with ASD and DD/ID (3.98 ± 1.22 years, range from 1.26 to 6.93 years, 472 males), 212 children diagnosed with ASD without DD/ID (3.24 ± 1.15 years, range from 1.13 to 6.95 years, 184 males)"

sex.detail: ASD with DD/ID: 472 males / 91 females (83.8% male). ASD without DD/ID: 184 males / 28 females (86.8% male). Combined: 656 males, 119 females (84.6% / 15.4%). Female counts derived by subtracting males from total N. Percentages consistent with Supplementary Table S2.
sex.supporting_text: "563 children diagnosed with ASD and DD/ID (... 472 males), 212 children diagnosed with ASD without DD/ID (... 184 males)"

disorder-name.detail: Developmental delay and/or intellectual disability (DD/ID) group without ASD diagnosis (n=36). Classified as both DD (Developmental delay) and ID (Intellectual disability) as the paper groups them together. Diagnosis based on GDS < 75 (for children under 4) or full IQ < 70 (WPPSI/WISC-R). ASD was excluded via DSM-5 criteria.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "36 children with DD/ID only (4.42 ± 1.4 years, range from 1.26 to 6.8 years, 25 males)"

dataset-of-origin.detail: All participants recruited from the Shanghai Autism Early Developmental (SAED) Cohort, from Xinhua Hospital, Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine.

age.detail: DD/ID only group (n=36), 4.42±1.40 years, range 1.26–6.80. Values reported directly in main text and confirmed in Supplementary Table S2.
